page_title: LIL 3-0 HAV | Lille v Le Havre 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+2' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) makes a strong challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Tiago Morais (Lille) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
89' Le Havre are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
88' It's a throw-in for Lille.
86' Tiago Morais (Lille) takes a short corner kick.
84' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Christopher Operi (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) replaces Angel Gomes.
82' Substitution. Abdoulaye Toure is replaced by Simon Ebonog (Le Havre).
81' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Lucas Chevalier as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
80' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
77' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
76' A short pass finds Yusuf Yazici (Lille) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
76' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
75' Here is a change. Remy Cabella is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Tiago Morais (Lille).
75' Substitution. Jonathan David walks off the pitch and Yusuf Yazici (Lille) comes on as a substitute.
74' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
73' Remy Cabella (Lille) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
71' Loic Nego (Le Havre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
69' Substitution. Andre Ayew makes his way off the pitch and Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) comes on as his replacement.
68' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) for his blatant foul.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Ounas trots off the pitch and is replaced by Edon Zhegrova (Lille).
65' Paulo Fonseca has decided to substitute Nabil Bentaleb and he is replaced by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille).
65' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
64' Tiago Santos (Lille) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
62' Substitution. Yassine Kechta did his best and is replaced by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).
61' Great chance! Jonathan David (Lille) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies a whisker wide of the right post.
60' Jonathan David (Lille) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the top left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Arthur Desmas, who pulls off a stunning save!
58' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
57' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
56' Loic Nego (Le Havre) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
54' The current number of shots on goal is 7:1.
51' Lille string together a series of short passes.
49' 3 - 0 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 3:0.

49' Jonathan David (Lille) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up and sends the ball to the bottom left corner, but Arthur Desmas keeps his cool to thwart him.
48' Jonathan David (Lille) is going to take the penalty!
48' Adam Ounas (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
47' Lille are given a penalty! Jeremie Pignard blows the whistle, Christopher Operi (Le Havre) is penalised for a foul.
46' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Josue Casimir comes off for Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
46' Luka Elsner makes a switch. Loic Nego is coming on in place of Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 2 - 0 Jonathan David (Lille) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Angel Gomes, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
44' Adam Ounas (Lille) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
42' Jonathan David (Lille) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.
40' Remy Cabella (Lille) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
39' Jonathan David (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
36' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) has tested the patience of referee Jeremie Pignard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
34' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Le Havre was in an offside position.
34' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle. Remy Cabella (Lille) commits a foul after dangerous play. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Le Havre.
32' It looks like Jonathan David (Lille) saw red with that tackle. Jeremie Pignard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
29' Remy Cabella (Lille) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
28' Adam Ounas (Lille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' Remy Cabella (Lille) is flagged for offside.
22' Neat passing move from Le Havre in order to create new attacking opportunities.
20' Benjamin Andre (Lille) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
19' Remy Cabella (Lille) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
18' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

14' Leny Yoro (Lille) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt to the right side of the goal fails to beat Arthur Desmas, who makes a sensational save.
13' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Lille.
13' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) jumps into a tackle and Jeremie Pignard signals a foul. Lille earn a free kick.
12' Half-chance! Adam Ounas (Lille) plays a pass into the box, but Arthur Desmas reacts well to snuff out the attack.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
9' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
5' The shot by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Lucas Chevalier.
5' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Le Havre force their opponents to concede a corner.

3' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Lucas Chevalier, who tips the ball around the post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Le Havre will kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard is the one to supervise the game today.
